eval_cases.context:

SELECT store_id,
       SUM(subtotal_amount - discount + tax_amount) AS net_transaction_revenue

WHERE business_date = CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY store_id
ORDER BY net_transaction_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
